desc: Derive combinational contribution via linearity: fixed value v in length class l contributes v·Σ_{S⊆others} |S|!(N-1-|S|)!·10^{total length of S}, captured by (1+a_l x)^{c_l-1}·∏_{m≠l}(1+a_m x)^{c_m}.
Confirm formula on small cases (N=3 → 1332; N=2 → 33) and validate the recurrence coefficients.
Group integers 1..N by digit length; compute c_l (count) and s_l (sum of values mod MOD) for each class, with a_l=10^l mod MOD.
Build P(x)=∏_l (1+a_l x)^{c_l} via the logarithmic-derivative recurrence (P'D=PC) in O(len(classes)·N) using precomputed modular inverses; build D and C.
For each active length class compute q=P/(1+a_l x) via q_k=p_k-a_l q_{k-1} and accumulate s_l·Σ_k k!(N-1-k)!·q_k.
Implement the final Python program (stdin N → stdout answer, mod 998244353) and verify all three provided samples (PASSED).
